JOYSTAR StarMoto 20 24 Inch Electric Mountain Bike for Teenagers

⚡ BUY AN E-BIKE & ENJOY SPECIAL HELMET PRICING! *Important: You must add the helmet to your cart for the discount to apply automatically.

Ignite their sense of adventure with the JOYSTAR StarMoto 20" Electric Bike. Designed specifically for riders aged 7–12, this electric mountain bike (eMTB) blends rugged durability with a powerful 250W motor, making neighborhood commutes and trail exploration easier than ever.

The ultimate entry-level electric mountain bike for teenagers: JOYSTAR StarMoto Series.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered for versatile riding on urban streets or off-road trails, providing a casual and carefree experience for young riders."
Power Up Your Ride
Equipped with a reliable 250W high-speed brushless motor and a 24V/5.2Ah lithium battery, the StarMoto reaches speeds up to 15.5 MPH. It handles steep hills and long neighborhood stretches without fatigue, making it a safe and reliable partner for school commutes or outdoor fun.

Ready for adventure: The StarMoto handles urban streets and trails with ease.

Advanced Safety Standards

Advanced Braking: Front and rear mechanical disc brakes provide reliable stopping power in any conditions.

High-Strength Build: Features a durable carbon steel frame designed to handle various road conditions and daily use.

All-Terrain Tires: 20" x 2.25" wide tires offer superior grip and stability for a smooth riding experience.

Removable Battery: The 24V/5.2Ah lithium battery is removable for easy and convenient indoor charging.

Adjustable Fit: Features an adjustable seat height to accommodate growing riders.

Watch the JOYSTAR StarMoto in action: High-performance fun in every color.

Size Chart & Fit Guide
Ensuring the correct fit is critical for safety and comfort. Use the guide below to determine if the StarMoto 20" 24" is the right match for your rider.

Recommended for teenagers and kids between 46" and 62" in height.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Don't waste time on complicated setups. The StarMoto arrives 85% pre-assembled. Our package includes all necessary tools to get the bike trail-ready quickly, so your teenager can start riding in minutes.

Watch: Fast assembly guide to go from box to pavement quickly.

Our Guarantee
Every Starmoto is engineered for durability and backed by a Limited Lifetime Frame Warranty. We extend our commitment beyond the metal: the motor, battery, and controller are protected by a comprehensive 1-year technical guarantee.
"From the first ride to the next adventure, our dedicated US-based support team is here to ensure your family stays in motion with zero downtime."
At JOYSTAR, we stand behind our craftsmanship to provide a reliable, high-performance experience for every young rider. Whether you need maintenance tips or technical assistance, we are committed to keeping your adventure going.
